title: artemisia gallica var. gargantae
intro: Artemisia gallica var. gargantae, commonly known as French tarragon, is a plant species native to Europe, known for its distinctive, slightly bitter flavor and aroma. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of French tarragon include its use as a digestive aid, anti-flatulent, and antispasmodic. Its bioactive constituents include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
